subject: Exec intro — availability matrix & short demo slot batching

Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — VP / CIO on a short demo (30min)

Hi Dylan,

Quick intro — I’m Samir on the GTM team at Ionix; we’re running procurement for GliderTech and they asked for a quick technical/exec overview with Redwood. They want a sharp 25–30 minute session for their VP of Product and CIO (both prefer a short, focused look at latency, cost controls, and the dedicated/private deployment story).

Can you confirm whether we can get a senior presence (VP or Director-level), and what short windows you have next week? To help move things quickly I pulled a small availability matrix below — happy to shift on our side: 

- Tue 6/9: 09:00–10:00 PT or 15:00–16:00 PT
- Wed 6/10: 11:30–12:30 PT (tight)
- Thu 6/11: 14:00–15:00 PT

If none of those work, we can compress to a 20-minute slot in the morning; main ask is exec presence + a one-slide agenda covering SLA/quantization and on-prem options.

I looked over your public specs but we’ll send specific compliance questions separately. Attaching a one-pager from GliderTech about scope (they asked me to share).

Thanks — Samir

Samir — thanks for the context and the times. I can cover this personally as AE lead but want to loop in Ben (sales lead for GliderTech) and Kim (product lead) for the exec parts.

Ben/Kim — FYI: GliderTech would like VP/CIO-level presence for a 25–30 minute demo that focuses on latency, cost levers, and private deployment options. Samir suggested Tue/Wed/Thu windows next week. Can either of you join as the senior sponsor? If not, can you recommend who should (VP/Head of Sales or Director of Product)?

I’ve penciled Thu 6/11 14:00–14:30 PT as a provisional slot — that keeps it short while giving time for a quick pre-demo 15-minute prep if needed. If that works, I’ll send a calendar hold and attach a concise agenda and ask list.

Also attaching a one-slide outline for the exec portion (saves time).

Thanks — D

Samir / Lauren — any specific procurement questions you want on the commercial slide? If there are security/compliance items we should pre-bake answers for, please flag.

- Dylan: send calendar hold to execs and GliderTech contacts; include 15-min pre-demo sync 30 minutes before the slot.
- Kim: attach the technical one-pager that maps to the agenda.

- Can you include one slide on KMS/HSM integrations and one line on retention/windowing for KV cache?

Dylan — please send the calendar invite with the attached agenda and Ben/Kim’s names as presenters. We’ll send a short attendee list on Monday.
